head_commit.message:
Support sourced MCP stdio env vars

Allow stdio MCP env_vars entries to opt into local or remote sourcing while preserving the existing string form. Remote source names are inherited from the executor side through the existing process env policy, while local/default entries continue to be copied from Codex as explicit overlays.

Add config, launcher, and remote-aware MCP tests that cover legacy env vars, local source vars, remote source filtering, and the effective executor env policy.
